name: shop-serve~p1
task: Each time a client arrives, take their order, get food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove and hand it over; should the food fall, your very next move must pick it up.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Existence(order_taken) and Existence(holding_food) ensure that the client's order is taken and food is prepared; the Precedence(client_arrived, switch_toggled) and Precedence(order_taken, food_prepared) ensure that the switch is toggled and food is prepared only after the client arrives and order is taken; the RespondedExistence(food_fell, holding_food) ensures that if food falls, it is picked up immediately.

texts: should the food fall, pick it up on the very next move
